# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** the Creek  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a buxom young French girl with a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary Joe is characterized as a silly and ignorant girl. She is described as someone whose words should not be a cause for concern.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)_

## Traits

- presumed silly, ignorant (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

## History

Mary Joe is a young woman who has never seen anyone suffer from croup. When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) falls ill with the condition while Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is away, Mary Joe is unable to assist, prompting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to seek help from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

Mary Joe works for [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md), having joined her household as a domestic helper. In this capacity, she lives alongside [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) and carries out chores and duties under her authority.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036)_
